seo_tagline: Custom software, managed hosting and AI chatbots
seo_description: Our Solution builds custom web and mobile apps, hosts ready-made business tools for you, and runs answr.id, an AI chatbot for your website. One team that builds it, hosts it and keeps it running.
seo_pricing_description: Our Solution Hosting plans: apps like n8n set up, backed up, monitored and updated for you, plus ready-made workflows you buy once.
footer_blurb: Software solutions, hosting solutions and the answr.id chatbot, from one team.
home_hero_copy: {brand} is a software studio with its own hosting. We design and ship the system your business needs, run ready-made tools on servers we manage, and make answr, an AI chatbot for your website.
home_services_copy: Have us build your software, run a ready-made tool on our servers, or add our AI chatbot to your site.
home_why_title: Built by us, run by us.
home_why_1_body: The people who build your system are the people who host and maintain it. Nothing gets lost in a handover.
home_why_2_body: Projects start with a plan and an estimate. Hosting plans show their price up front in the shop.
home_why_3_body: Monitoring, backups, updates and the next round of improvements are part of the job, not an afterthought.
home_cta_copy: Tell us what slows your team down and we will reply with a plan and an estimate. Or pick a hosting plan in the shop and start today.
pricing_hero_copy: Hosting runs by the period. Workflows are yours after one purchase.
svc_software_tagline: Custom software, built around how you work.
svc_software_summary: You have a process to fix. We plan, design and build the web or mobile app for it, then stay on after launch.
svc_software_point_1: A plan and an estimate before any code
svc_software_point_2: Working releases you can try each week
svc_software_intro: Dashboards, portals, mobile apps and integrations, built by one team that also hosts and maintains them. Nothing falls between an agency, a freelancer and a server nobody owns.
svc_software_f1_body: Dashboards, portals and internal tools built around how you work.
svc_software_f2_body: Replace paper, spreadsheets and chat threads with clear workflows.
svc_software_f3_body: Connect payments, messaging and the systems you already use.
svc_software_f4_body: Hosting, CI/CD, backups and monitoring, set up properly.
svc_software_f5_body: Updates, fixes and new features after launch.
svc_software_s1_body: We learn your goals, your users and the process you want to fix.
svc_software_s2_body: Flows, screens and architecture you approve before we build.
svc_software_s3_body: Short iterations with working releases you can try each week.
svc_software_s4_body: Functional, security and performance checks before go-live.
svc_software_s5_body: Deployment, data migration and training for your team.
svc_software_s6_body: Hosting, monitoring, maintenance and the next round of improvements.
svc_hosting_tagline: Ready-made tools, hosted and looked after for you.
svc_hosting_summary: You need a tool, not a project. Pick a ready-made app like n8n and we host, monitor and update it for you.
svc_hosting_point_1: Ready-made apps like n8n, hosted for you
svc_hosting_point_2: We run the servers, backups and updates
svc_hosting_point_3: Extend or stop a subscription anytime
svc_hosting_intro: The same infrastructure we run client projects on, sold as simple plans in our shop. You use the tool, we keep it up.
svc_hosting_f1_body: Tools like n8n, set up for you, plus workflows to start from.
svc_hosting_f2_body: Your data is backed up for you, without anything to configure.
svc_hosting_f3_body: We watch your instance so problems are caught on our side.
svc_hosting_f4_body: We apply updates, so you are not left on an old version.
svc_hosting_f5_body: Everything you run with us, and its status, in one place.
svc_hosting_f6_body: Subscriptions run by the period. Extend or stop anytime.
svc_hosting_s1_body: Choose the app and the period you want in the shop.
svc_hosting_s2_body: Create an account and pay. No call or contract needed.
svc_hosting_s3_body: Your instance is deployed on our servers, ready to use.
svc_hosting_s4_title: You use it, we run it
svc_hosting_s4_body: Follow it from your dashboard and extend whenever you like.
svc_answr_tagline: An AI chatbot for your website.
svc_answr_summary: An AI assistant you embed on your site with one script tag. It answers visitors from your own knowledge.
svc_answr_point_2: Added to your site with one script tag
svc_answr_intro: answr is our own product: a chatbot that answers your visitors using the knowledge you give it, so common questions get an answer at any hour.
svc_answr_f1_body: It answers from the information you provide, not from guesswork.
svc_answr_f2_body: Paste one line into your site and the assistant appears.
svc_answr_f3_body: Visitors get an answer straight away, day or night.
svc_answr_f4_body: Built and hosted by the same team behind everything else here.
svc_answr_s1_body: Give answr the information your visitors usually ask about.
svc_answr_s2_body: Paste the script tag into your website.
svc_answr_s3_body: The assistant replies on your site using your knowledge.
